result.summary: The page is largely intact; the only notable visual defect is a stuck/visible loading spinner overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image. Partial carousel clipping on the right and the bottom card being cut by the viewport were treated as intended features per instructions.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, making the restaurant card look unfinished or stuck while loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image finishes loading and hide the spinner once loaded; if the image fails, show a retry state or placeholder instead of leaving a persistent loader over content.
